steps.message:
Here's a summary of the bug fix:

## Bug Analysis

**Location:** `TagsHelper.java`, method `removeTag()` (lines 87-93)

**Root cause:** Two defects in `String.replaceAll()`:

1. **Substring matching**: `replaceAll("#test", "")` treats `#test` as a regex and matches `#test` as a **substring** of `#testa`, `#testb`, etc. So when removing `#test`, it would corrupt `#testa` → `a`, `#testb` → `b`.

2. **Global replacement**: `replaceAll()` replaces **all** occurrences, so if the same tag appeared multiple times in a note, all instances would be stripped when only one checkbox was unchecked.

## Fix Applied

| Before (buggy) | After (fixed) |
|---|---|
| `title = title.replaceAll(tagToRemove.getText(), "");` | `title = title.replaceFirst(pattern, "");` |
| `content = content.replaceAll(tagToRemove.getText(), "");` | `content = content.replaceFirst(pattern, "");` |

**Key changes:**
- **`Pattern.quote()`** — escapes any regex special characters in the tag text
- **`(?<!\\S)`** — negative lookbehind ensures the tag is preceded by whitespace or is at the start of string
- **`(?!\\w)`** — negative lookahead ensures the tag is NOT followed by a word character (prevents matching `#testa` when removing `#test`)
- **`replaceFirst()`** — removes only the first matching occurrence instead of all of them
